text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lady Petillant is breaking away, pulling 
ahead! A once-in-a-lifetime breakaway 
runaway run! Can the other Umamusume catch 
up?!

text_block_list.name: Lady Petillant
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! Look at that!! In a race... 
In a race...! Anything can happen!!

text_block_list.name: Lady Petillant
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just this once... I will 
shineee! —Dayaaaaaaaaaahhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Lady Petillant
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... P-Please, hold on a moment. 
I'm truly out of breath...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so sorry! Should I rub your back 
for you?

text_block_list.name: Lady Petillant
text_block_list.text:
"Well, Buena-san? How did it feel watching 
my back?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...You were so, so cool. You looked 
positively dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
My heart was pounding wondering if I could 
catch up... Races are terrifying things... 
I've truly engraved that into my heart!

text_block_list.name: Lady Petillant
text_block_list.text:
"You debuted alongside me... Just like 
Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet, you're someone 
who will keep surging to the top."

text_block_list.name: Lady Petillant
text_block_list.text:
"Please bring even more excitement to the 
Tiara route. But... never forget that even 
when out of the spotlight, everyone is 
always striving for victory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through her battles with the Senior 
Class... Buena Vista seemed to have 
discovered yet another exciting side to 
racing.
